deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy && node apps/api/dist/main.js

//: Railway config for the API service. The worker + web apps are SEPARATE Railway services in the same project (one Dockerfile each). PostgreSQL and Redis are Railway plugins (managed), shared by API+worker within an environment. Railway 'environments' (staging/production) each get their own plugins, so Redis is never shared across environments — and app-level env-namespacing (P6.2) is defence-in-depth. See docs/p6/P6.1-CLOUD-DEPLOYMENT.md for the worker/web service definitions, required variables, and the staging→production promotion flow. Secrets are set as Railway service variables, never committed.
